full_text:
Dvergr viaduct

Type: Structure | Internal ID: Mistlands_Viaduct1 | Mistlands_Viaduct2 | Location: Mistlands

Introduction. Dvergr viaducts are structure made of Black marble found in the Mistlands. They have from 1 to 3 pillars and an internal structure made of Cage floor 2x2 and Cage wall 2x2.

Drops. Part of the pillar is buried in the ground, making certain resources difficult to access.

Tips. • When the base of the pillars are destroyed the full structure collapse and yields large quantities of Black marble and Iron at low effort.
• A Hammer with a nearby Stonecutter can destroy all the viaduct parts.
